hook_card.text:
نقصتي الكيلوات… وبانو الخطوط؟
السبب واحد: الجلد تقطع من لتحت
hook_card.red: السبب واحد: الجلد تقطع من لتحت

shots.vo_line: حبسي… أنا الخط اللي ففخدتك وجنبك. نقصتي الكيلوات، ولبستي السروال القديم… وبنت
shots.row: On the thigh character's outer thigh, the white stretch mark comes alive with a sports cap and a sly grin
shots.h3_prompt: The capped villain lifts a finger to his lips, then tips his cap with a sly grin. The villain talks with clear, natural mouth movement and expressive gestures while the thigh character takes small bouncy steps on the spot, smiling, unaware. He leans back smugly, hands on hips, wiggling his eyebrows until the end. Static camera. No speech bubbles, no text, no new objects. One continuous shot from this first frame: the same characters, design, colours, setting and lighting for the whole clip; no new characters, no humans, no hands, no speech bubbles, no text or letters anywhere, no scene cut.

shots.vo_line: أنا. حمر فالأول، ومن بعد بيض. ودابا ولّيتي كتلبسي الصاية الطويلة حتى فالصيف.
shots.row: The thigh character holding huge old jeans, then wearing a long skirt on a sunny day
shots.h3_prompt: The thigh character holds the huge jeans up against herself and her eyes widen at the loose waist. She lets the jeans droop and sighs, glancing sadly at the stretch marks on her side. She keeps shifting her weight from foot to foot, pouting and slumping. Static camera. No speech bubbles, no text, no new objects. One continuous shot from this first frame: the same characters, design, colours, setting and lighting for the whole clip; no new characters, no humans, no hands, no speech bubbles, no text or letters anywhere, no scene cut.
shots.frame_issue: Speaker (the capped villain) is not in this frame, so no talking; the row's second half (long skirt on a sunny day) is not in the frame.

shots.vo_line: وماشي الريجيم اللي جابني. ملي زدتي فالوزن بالزربة، الجلد تجبد وتقطع من لتحت. وملي نقصتي، الجلد رخا… وبنت.
shots.row: Flashback inside the thigh: tissue stretching fast, threads snapping; fat-cell cushions deflating; the villain standing up proudly
shots.h3_prompt: The snapped fibres hanging from the ceiling quiver and spring loose one by one while the yellow fat cushions slowly deflate and sag. The capped villain talks with clear, natural mouth movement and expressive gestures while he rises up proudly between them. He puffs out his chest and keeps bobbing smugly while the small pink mark nods along. Static camera. No speech bubbles, no text, no new objects. One continuous shot from this first frame: the same characters, design, colours, setting and lighting for the whole clip; no new characters, no humans, no hands, no speech bubbles, no text or letters anywhere, no scene cut.
shots.frame_issue: Villain's cap is grey/orange here but pink in A4-01 and A4-05.

shots.vo_line: ونتي؟ كديري الرياضة: الرياضة كتشد العضلات، ماشي الجلد. كتدهني الكريمة: كتبقى فوق.
shots.row: A dumbbell bouncing off a muscle wall below; cream stuck on the ceiling; a coffee bowl with red sparks; a laser with a price on its screen; the villain lying back on a soft pink cushion, sunglasses on
shots.h3_prompt: The little dumbbell bounces off the muscle floor and springs back up, again and again. The cream blobs on the ceiling wobble and droop but stay stuck. The villain talks with clear, natural mouth movement and expressive gestures while lounging on the cushion, pointing lazily at the dumbbell, then up at the cream. Static camera. No speech bubbles, no text, no new objects. One continuous shot from this first frame: the same characters, design, colours, setting and lighting for the whole clip; no new characters, no humans, no hands, no speech bubbles, no text or letters anywhere, no scene cut.
shots.frame_issue: Villain wears BOTH the crown (Ad-1 / C3 villain) and the cap; the cap front has a red logo-like mark; the dumbbell has a face; the laser has no price screen (price must come from the VO/overlay).

shots.vo_line: القهوة مع السكر: كتحمّرك وصافي. والليزر: 1500 درهم للمرة. وأنا هنا، متكي ومرتاح.
shots.row: A dumbbell bouncing off a muscle wall below; cream stuck on the ceiling; a coffee bowl with red sparks; a laser with a price on its screen; the villain lying back on a soft pink cushion, sunglasses on
shots.h3_prompt: The red sparks over the coffee bowl crackle and the laser on the right blinks and fires short red beams. The villain talks with clear, natural mouth movement and expressive gestures while he waves them off lazily. He laces his hands behind his head, sinks into the cushion and keeps wiggling his toes, relaxed. Static camera. No speech bubbles, no text, no new objects. One continuous shot from this first frame: the same characters, design, colours, setting and lighting for the whole clip; no new characters, no humans, no hands, no speech bubbles, no text or letters anywhere, no scene cut.
shots.frame_issue: Same frame as s04: crown + cap on the villain, logo-like mark on the cap.

shots.vo_line: …لا لا لا، شنو هادشي؟ غوتيفا؟ سيروم خفيف كيدخل حتى لعندي؟! زيت أركان وفيتامين E كيغذيو
shots.row: Golden spotlights; a Guttiva drop arriving from above; the villain jumping off the cushion in panic
shots.h3_prompt: The golden drop sinks slowly down through the spotlights in a sparkling spiral. The capped villain flails mid-air, his sunglasses tumbling, and lands beside the cushion in panic. The capped villain talks with clear, natural mouth movement and expressive gestures while he backs away trembling, eyes on the drop; the other two marks only blink. Static camera. One continuous shot from this first frame: the same characters, design, colours, setting and lighting for the whole clip; no new characters, no humans, no hands, no speech bubbles, no text or letters anywhere, no scene cut.
shots.frame_issue: Setting is a belly with a navel, not the thigh; the crowned villain and small pink mark from C3 (another ad's villain) are pasted in beside the capped one, and the capped villain is pink, not white - two villains can read as the speaker.

shots.vo_line: الجلد وكيعاونوه يبرا، والألوفيرا كتبرد الحمورية. ماشي بحال
shots.row: Golden spotlights; a Guttiva drop arriving from above; the villain jumping off the cushion in panic
shots.h3_prompt: The capped villain drops onto the skin, scrambles behind the cushion and peeks over its edge. The golden drop lands softly on the skin and sends out a warm ripple of light. The capped villain talks with clear, natural mouth movement and expressive gestures while he keeps peeking out, sweating and trembling; the other two marks only blink. Static camera. One continuous shot from this first frame: the same characters, design, colours, setting and lighting for the whole clip; no new characters, no humans, no hands, no speech bubbles, no text or letters anywhere, no scene cut.
shots.frame_issue: Same frame as s06: belly instead of thigh, extra crowned C3 villain + pink mark.

shots.vo_line: الرياضة اللي كتخدم على العضلة… هادا كيخدم على الجلد نيت. ما كيبقاش فوق بحال الكريمة، ما كيحكش بحال القهوة، وأرخص من الليزر بزاف. دقيقتين الصباح
shots.row: Serum drops raining down, threads re-joining, the villain turning pale and shrinking, then whispering from a tiny dark hole
shots.h3_prompt: Golden drops rain down gently and soak into the skin with small ripples as the glowing pink threads weave together and pull tight. The villain talks with clear, natural mouth movement and expressive gestures while his smug grin fades to worry. He slowly turns pale and shrinks lower, glancing nervously at the drops; the tiny face in the hole only blinks. Static camera. One continuous shot from this first frame: the same characters, design, colours, setting and lighting for the whole clip; no new characters, no humans, no hands, no speech bubbles, no text or letters anywhere, no scene cut.
shots.frame_issue: The villain here is the crowned C3 design (Ad 1), not Ad 4's capped one; belly with navel instead of the thigh; the dark hole below the navel (tiny whispering face) reads as a second navel.

shots.vo_line: والعشية… فـ30 يوم الحمرين كيخفّو، فـ60 أنا كنقرب للون ديال الجلد… لا، ما تلبسيش ديك الصاية القصيرة! وبلا ما تطلبي غوتيفا، خليني مرتاح هنا.
shots.row: Serum drops raining down, threads re-joining, the villain turning pale and shrinking, then whispering from a tiny dark hole
shots.h3_prompt: Golden drops keep raining softly. The villain flinches, turns pale and sinks flat into the skin until only a faint line is left. The tiny face in the dark hole talks with clear, natural mouth movement and expressive gestures while it whispers, finger to its lips, glancing around nervously until the end. Static camera. One continuous shot from this first frame: the same characters, design, colours, setting and lighting for the whole clip; no new characters, no humans, no hands, no speech bubbles, no text or letters anywhere, no scene cut.
shots.frame_issue: Same frame as s08: crowned villain instead of the capped one, belly instead of thigh; the whisper from the hole is the tiny face (talking).

shots.row: End card: the pink Guttiva bottle + end-card text

shots.vo_line: للخطوط اللي فبزاف د البلايص. التوصيل فابور، وكتخلصي ملي توصلك.
shots.row: End card: the pink Guttiva bottle + end-card text
